## Installation

### Windows
- **Recommended**: [WikiShield-Setup-1.0.0-dev3.exe](https://github.com/LuniZunie/WikiShield-App/releases/download/v1.0.0-dev3/WikiShield-Setup-1.0.0-dev3.exe)
  - Full installer with auto-update support
  - Creates desktop and start menu shortcuts

### Linux

## Auto-Updates
All installers support automatic updates. The app will check for new versions and notify you when an update is available.
